case_title: TRINITY CAPITAL CORPORATION VS. DUKE SMITH et al

docket_entries.description: CONTRACT/WARRANTY, COMPLAINT FILED BY PLAINTIFF TRINITY CAPITAL CORPORATION AS TO DEFENDANT SMITH, DUKE INDIVIDUALLY AND DBA MASTER TECH AUTOMOTIVE DOES ONE THROUGH TEN INCLUSIVE SUMMONS ISSUED, JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR MAY-27-2005 PROOF OF SERVICE DUE ON                  MAR-28-2005 CASE MANAGEMENT STATEMENT DUE ON         MAY-12-2005
DISMISSAL WITHOUT PREJUDICE OF COMPLAINT AS TO DEFENDANT DOES ONE THROUGH TEN INCLUSIVE

CAUSE CALLED, THE COURT ORDERED THAT PLAINTIFF TRINITY CAPITAL CORPORATION HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SMITH, DUKE INDIVIDUALLY AND DBA MASTER TECH AUTOMOTIVE POSSESSION OF THE FOLLOWING DESCRIBED PROPERTY, TO WIT: MTS 3100 MASTERTECH KIT; ONE GM SPS PASS THRU REPROGRAMMING ALL MODULES KIT, OR IN CASE A DELIVERY OF SAID PROPERTY TO PLAINTIFF CANNOT BE HAD, THEN THAT THE PLAINTIFF HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT $4,576.79 DAMAGES, $800.00 ATTORNEY FEES, $216.30 COSTS, $86.25 INTEREST, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,679.34, FAIR MARKET VALUE = $1700.00 SEE JUDGMENT AT LENGTH; SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT
PRE-TRIAL CALENDAR SWEEP, CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE CALENDAR OF MAY-27-2005, OFF CALENDAR, DISMISSAL OR JUDGMENT ON FILE AS TO ALL DEFENDANTS
